m: पुट् cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 74) पुटति, to clasp, fold, envelop in (instr.), Bhpr.; to rub together with (instr. ib.); cl. 1. P. पोटति, to grind, pound, Dhātup. ix, 38 (v.l. for मुट्); cl. 10. P. पुटयति, to be in contact with, xxxv, 58 पोटयति, to speak or to shine (भाषार्थे or भासार्थे), xxxiii, 80; to grind or pound, xxxii, 72; Vop.; to be small, xxxii, 24 (v.l. for पुट्ट्).
a: पुट् — {vI.v} {c6c} P. (पटति) 1 To embrace, clasp. --2 To intertwine. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (पुटयति-ते) 1 To be in contact with. --2 To bind together, fasten. --3 (पोटयति-ते) (a) To grind, reduce to powder. (b) To speak. (c) To shine. {vIII.v} {c1c} P. (पोटति) 1 To grind. --2 To rub.

m: पुटाञ्जलि m. the two hollowed hands put together (cf. अञ्जलि), Hcat.
पुटाह्वय m. = पुट-पाक, Suśr.

a: पुटी — A small piece of cloth worn over the privities; (for other senses see पुट).

s: ka cUrRe । BAsi । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAM-paraM-cUrRe sakaM-BAsi akaM-sew .) ka, powayati । BAsi dIptO । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
t ka saMsarge । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (adantacurAM-paraM-sakaM-sew .) puwayati puzpaM sUtreRa janaH saMsfjatItyarTaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
Si Sleze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudAM-kuwAMparaM-akaM-sew .) Si, puwati apuwIt pupowa । SlezaH sambanDIBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

klI, (puwatIti । puwa saMSleze + kaH .) jAtIPalam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ uparyyaDoBAvApannasaMyuktamfdAdikapAladvayarUpOzaDapAkapAtram । DAtvAdimAraRopayuktAn puwaprakArAnAha rasapradIpe । “lohAderapunarBAvastadguRatvaM guRAQyatA । salile taraRaYcApi tatsidDiH puwanAdBavet ॥ gamBIre vistfte kuRqe dvihaste caturasrake । vanopalasahasreRa pUrite puwanOzaDam ॥ kozWe rudDaM prayatnena govizWopari DArayet । vanopalasahasrArdDaM kozWikopari niHkzipet ॥ vahniM viniHkzipettatra mahApuwamiti smftam ॥ 1 ॥ kozWaM mUzA । govizWA goiWA । iti mahApuwam ॥ sapAdahastamAnena kuRqe nimne taTAyate । vanopalasahasreRa pUrRamaDye viDArayet ॥ puWanadravyasaMyuktAM kozWikAM mudritAM muKe । aDo'rdDAni karaRqAni ardDAnyupari niHkzipet ॥ etadgajapuwaM proktaM KyAtaM sarvvapuwottamam ॥ hastaScaturvviMSatyaNgulapramARaH sa sapAdaH tena triMSadaNgulapramARenetyarTaH । ataevoktam । sADAraRo narANgulyA triMSadaNgulako gajaH ॥ iti gajapuwam ॥ 2 ॥ aratnimAtrake kuRqe puwaM vArAhamucyate ॥ 3 ॥ vitastimAtrake KAte kaTitaM kOkkuwaM puwam । ‘aratnistu nizkanizWena muzwinA’ ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 86 ॥ niHsftakanizWayA muzwyopalakzito hasto'ratnirityarTaH । zoqaSANgulake KAte kasyacit kOkkuwaM puwam ॥ 4 ॥ yat puwaM dIyate KAte hyazwasaMKyErvanopalEH । kapotapuwametattu kaTitaM puwapaRqitEH ॥ 5 ॥ gozWAntargoKurakzuRRaM SuzkacUrRitagomayam । govaraM tat samAKyAtaM varizWaM rasasADane ॥ bfhadBARqasTitEryantrErgovarErdIyate puwam । tadgovarapuwaM proktaM BizagBiH sUtaBasmakft ॥ 6 ॥ bfhadBARqe tuzEH pUrRe maDye mUzAM viDArayet । kziptvAgniM mudrayedBARqaM tadBARqapuwamucyate ॥” * ॥ iti BAvaprakASe pUrvvaKaRqe 2 BAgaH ॥
puM klI, (puwatIti । puwa Sleze + kaH .) aSvaKuraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥

tri, (puw + kaH .) AcCAdanam । patrAdiracitaH puzpAdyADAraH । yaTA, raGuH । 2 । 65 । “dugDvA payaH patrapuwe madIyaM puttropaBuNkzveti tamAdideSa ॥” (yaTA ca manO । 6 । 28 । “grAmAdAhftya vASnIyAdazwO grAsAn vane vasan । pratigfhya puwenEva pARinA sakalena vA ॥”) miTaHsaMSlezaH । iti mukuwaH ॥ ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥

na॰ puwa--ka । 1 jAtIPale rAjani॰ 2 uparyyaGoBAvApannena mfdAdikapAsadvayena girmite ozaDapAkazAtraBede ca pa॰ 3 aSvakzure pu॰ na॰ Sabdara॰ । 4 miTaHsamyanTe 5 AcCAdage caMpuwaBedanamityamaravyAKyAyAM sukuwaH । 6 pattrAdiracite dugDAdipAnapAtre tri॰ (donA) striyAM NIz । OzaDapAkapAtraprakAraH BAvapra॰ ukto yaTA “DAtvAdimAraRopayuktAn puwaprakArAnAha rasapradIpe “lohAderapunarBAvastadguRatvaM guRAQyatA salile taraRaYcApi tatsinniH puwanAdBavet । gamBIre vistfte kuRqe dvihaste caturasmake । vanopaRasahasneRa pUritaM punarOzaDam । kIzWe rudDe prayatnena govizWopari DArayet । vanopalasahasrArdDaM kozWikopari niHkzipet । vahniM viniHkzepettatra mahApuwamiti smftam” । kozWaM mfRmUzA govizWA (goiwA) । mahApuwam । “sapAda hastamAnena kuRqe nimne taTAyate । vanopalasahasneRa pUrRe maDye viDArayet । puwanadravyasaMyuktAM kozWikAM mudritAM muKe । aTArdDAni karaRqAni ardDAnDupari niHkzipet । etadgajapuwaM proktaM KyAtaM sarvapuwottamam” । hastaScaturBiMSatyaNgulapraBAKaH sa sapAdaH tena triMSadaNgalapramAlenetyarTaH ataevoktam “sAGAraKanarANgulyA triMSadaNgalako gajaH” iti gajapuwam । “aratnimAtrake kuRqe puwaM vArAhamucyate । vitastimAtrake KAte kaTitaM kOkvuwaM puwam” । aratristu “nizkanizWena muzwinA” ityamaraH । niHsftakanizwayA muzwyopalakzito hasto'ratnirityarTaH । “zoqaSANgulake KAte kasyacit kOkkuwaM puwam । yatpuwaM dIyate KAte azwasaMKyErvanopalEH । kapotapuwametattu kazitaM puwapaRqitEH । gozWAntargosvurakzuRaM SuzkaM cUrRitagomayam । govaraM tatsamAKyAtaM varizaM rasalADane । vfhadBARqaKyitEryatra govarErdIyate puwam । tadgovarapuwaM proktaM BizagBiH sUtamaKani । vfhadBARqe tuzEH pUrRe maDye mUzAM viDArayet । kziptvAgniM mudrayet BARqaM tadBARqaM puwamucyate” । “vasuyugaviratirnO ByO puwo'yam” vf॰ ra॰ ukte udvAdaRAkzarapAdake CandoBede pu॰
m: पुट m. n. a fold, pocket, hollow space, slit, concavity (ifc. f. आ), Mn.; MBh. &c. (also f(ई). , Śāntiś.)
a cloth worn to cover the privities (also f(ई). ), W.
a horse's hoof, L.
an eyelid (cf. -भेद)
पुट m. a cup or basket or vessel made of leaves, ŚBr. (cf. ऊष-), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a casket (= सम्पुट), L.
the enveloping or wrapping of any substance (esp. for baking or heating it; cf. पुट-पाक), Bhpr.
any cake or pastry filled with seasoning or stuffing of any kind, ib.
N. of a metre (= श्री-पुट), L.
of a man g. अश्वादि
पुट n. a nutmeg, L.
two vessels joined together (for the sublimation of medicinal substances), W.
a: पुटः --टं — [पुट्-क] 1 A fold. --2 A hollow space, cavity, concavity; भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वन निलः R. 9. 68, 11. 23; 17. 12; M. 3. 9; अंजलिपट, नासापुट, कर्णपुट &c. --3 A cup made of a leaf folded or doubled; a vessel of leaves; दुग्ध्वा पयः पत्रपुटे मदीयं R. 2. 65: Ms. 6.-8. --4 Any shallow receptacle. --5 The pod or capsule which envelops young shoots. --6 A sheath, cover, covering. --7 An eyelid. (पुटी also in all these senses) --8 A horse's hoof. --टः 1 A casket. --2 The contracting of anything. --3 A folding of anything so as to form a cup. --टं 1 A nutmeg. --2 Two vessels joined together for medical purposes. --Comp. --उटजं a white umbrella. --उदकः a cocoa-nut. --ग्रीवः {1} a pot, jar, pitcher. {2} a copper-vessel. --पाकः {1} a particular method of preparing drugs, in which the various ingredients are wrapped up in leaves, and being covered with clay are roasted in the fire: अनिर्भिन्नो गभीरत्वादंतर्गूढघनव्यथः . पुटपाकप्रतीकाशो रामस्य करुणो रसः U. 3. 1. {2} digesting. {3} subliming. --भेदः {1} a town, city. {2} a kind of musical instrument (अ तोद्य). {3} ‘parting of the eyelids’, opening; U. 6. 3. {4} a whirl-pool or eddy. --भेदनं a town, city; Śi. 13. 26.

s: puM, (puwaM saMSlizwaM BinattIti । Bida + “karmmaRyaR .” 3 । 2 । 1 । ityaR .) nadIvakram । (nadIcakram । ityamaraH । 1 । 10 । 7 ॥ yaTA, AryyAsaptaSatyAm । 398 । “prAyeREva hi malinA malinAnAmASrayatvamupayAnti । kAlindIpuwaBedaH kAliyapuwaBedanaM Bavati ॥”) pattanam । Atodyam । iti medinI । de, 50 ॥
v: pu॰ puwaM saMhRezaM Binatti Bida--aK । nadyAdesakrAkAre 2 jalAvartte 3 pattame 4 nagare 5 Atodye ca medi॰ ।

‘parting of the eye-lids’, opening, Uttarar. vi, 3
a town, L.
a kind of musical instrument, L.

a: पुटकिनी — 1 A lotus. --2 A group of lotuses.

पुटन n. enveloping, wrapping up, Bhpr.

s: puM, (puwena pAkaH .) puwAByantaritOzaDapacanam । aTa puwapAkaviDiH । “puwapakvasya kalkasya svaraso gfhyate yataH । atastu puwapAkAnAM yuktiratrocyate mayA ॥ puwapAkasya pAko'yaM lepasyANgAravarRatA । lepaYca dvyaNgulaM sTUle kuryyAdbANgulimAtrakam ॥ kASmarIvawajambvAdipatrErvezwanamuttamam । palamAtro raso grAhyaH karzamAtraM maDu kzipet ॥ kalkacUrRadravAdyAstu deyAH kolamitA buDEH ॥ api ca । dve vilve snigDamAMsasya paraM dravyaM palaM matam । dravyasya kuqavonmAnaM sarvvamekatra pezayet ॥ tadekatra samAloqya patrEH sUparivezwitam ॥ puwapAkaviDAnena tat paktvA tadrasaM buDaH । tarpaRoktena viDinA yaTAvadavacArayet ॥ dfzwimaDye nizecyaH syAnnityamuttAnaSAyinaH । snehano leKanaScEva ropaRaSceti sa triDA ॥ hitaH snigDo virUkzasya snigDasya sa tu leKanaH dfzwerbbalArTamitaraH pittAsfgvraRavAtanut ॥ itaro ropaRaH । snehamAMsavasAmajjamedaHsvAdvOzaDEH kftaH । snehanaH puwapAkaH syAdDAryyo dve vAkSate tu saH ॥ vAkSataM CowikASatam । jANgalAnAM yakfnmAMsErleKanadravyasaMyutEH । kfzRaloharajastAmraSaNKavidrumasinDujEH ॥ samudraPenakAsIsasrotojadaDimastuBiH । leKano vAkSataM tasya paraM DAraRamizyate ॥ stanyajANgalamaDvAjyatiktakadravyaBAvitaH । leKanAttriguRo DAryyaH puwapAkastu ropaRaH ॥ tiktakadravyARyAha । nimbAmftAvfzapawolanidigDikABiH syAt paYcatiktaka iti praTito gaRo'yam ॥ AcarettarpaRoktAntu kriyAM vyApattidarSane ॥ vyApattidarSane miTyAkftapuwapAkajanitavyADidarSane । tejAMsyanilamAkASamAdarSaM BAskarARi ca । nEkzeta tarpite netre yaSca vA puwapAkavAn ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥
v: pu॰ puwena pAkaH । puwapAtreRa OzaDapAKe tadviDi Bedo BAvapra॰ ukto yaTA “aTa puwapAkaviDiH । puwapAkasya kalkasya svarasAM gfhyate yataH । atastu puwapAkAnAM yuktiratrocyate mayA । puwapAkena pAko'yaM lepasyANgAravarRatA । lepaYca dvyaNgulaM sTUlaM kuryyAdvyaNgusamAvyakam । kASmarIvawajambAdipatravezwanamuttamam । palamAtro raso grAhyaH karzamAtraM aDu kzipet । kalkacUrRadravAdyAstu deyAH kolamitA buDEH” । netrarogacikitsAyAmanyastatprakAra uktasyatra dfSyaH । cakrapARinA tu anyaTokto yaTA “hastapramARavadanaM SvaBraM hastEkaKAtasamagaDyam । kftvA kawAhasadfSaM tatra karIzaM turzaYca kAzWaYca । antarGanataraBardDaSumiraM paripUryya dahanamAyojya । paScAdayasaScUrRaM SlakzRaM paNkopanaM kuryyAt । triPalAmbuBfNgakesaraSatAvarikAkandamAnasahajarasEH । BallAtakakarikarRacCadamUlapunarnavAsvarasEH । kziptvATa lohapAtre mArha vA lOhamArdapAtrAByAm । tulyAByAM pfzWenAcCAdyAnye ranDramAlipya । tatpuwapAtraM tatra SvaBrajvalane niDAya BUyoBiH । mAzWakarIzatuzEstatsaMcCAdyAharniSaM dahet prAjYaH । evaM BavaBirmezajarAjEH pacet puwapARaM । pratyekamelameBirmilitE ryA tricaturAn vArAn । pratipuwanaM tat piMtyAt KyAlIpAkaM viDAya taTEva । tAdfSi dfSadi na piMzyAt vigaladrajasA tu yujyate yatra । tadayasUrRaM pizwaM dfzwaM GanasUkzmavAsasi SlakzRam । yadi rajamA sadfSaM syAt ketakyAstarhi tadBadram । puwane sTAlIpAke'Dikftapuruze svaBAvarugaDigamAt । kaTitamapi heyamOzaDamucitamupAdeyasanDadavi” ।
m: पुट—पाक m. a partic. method of preparing drugs (the various substances being wrapped up in leaves, covered with clay, and heated in fire), Car.; Bhpr.
digesting, subliming, W.
पुट—पाक—युक्ति f. the application of the method called पुट-पाक, Suśr.

s: strI, (puwaM astyasyA iti । puwa + Wan + wAp .) elA । iti hArAvalI । 97 ॥
m: पुटिका f. a bag or vessel (cf. m.), Pañc.
a bi-valved shell, L.
cardamoms, L.

m: पुटित mfn. split, torn up (= पाटित), L.
sewn, stitched (= स्यूत), L.
rubbed, ground, W.
contracted, W.
पुटित n. the hollow of the hands (= हस्तपुट), L.
a: पुटित — a. 1 Rubbed, ground. --2 Contracted. --3 Stitched, sewn. --4 Split. --तं The hollow of the hands.

s: puM, (puwe antaryubjapAtramaDye udakaM yasya .) nArikelaH । iti hArAvalI । 100 ॥
v: pu॰ puwaM saSlizwamudakaM yatra, puwe kapAlAkArapAtraBedamaDye udakaM vA yasya । nArikele hArA॰ ।
m: पुटोदक n. ‘having water in its hollow or interior’, a cocoa-nut, L.
पुटोटज n. a white umbrella or parasol, L.
पुट्ट् cl. 10. P. पुट्टयति, to be or become small, diminish, Dhātup. xxxii, 24 (v.l. पुट्).
a: पुट्ट् — {c10c} U. (पुट्टयति-त) 1 To become small, decrease, diminish. --2 To be low or shallow. --3 To disregard, disrespect.

v: anAdare cu॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । puwwayati--te apupuwwat--ta ।
